messages.subject: Particulars of Claim issued - HT-2026-000142
messages.plaintextBody:
Geoffrey,

We issued the Particulars of Claim in the Technology and Construction Court today (Claim No. HT-2026-000142). The claim is for £1,420,000 plus interest and costs. I attach the issued version as filed.

Helmsworth now have to file a Defence. Their solicitors will no doubt run the misuse argument and clause 14.2. Our priority now is the expert engineer and pinning down the lost-profit evidence via the Halcyon contract.

The court issue fee of £10,000 has been paid and is recoverable if we succeed.

Kind regards,
Tom

Tom Gallagher | Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
